caption: The toolbar on/off state and saved light-property values are independent.
alt: Lux enabled-state flow and persistent setting separation.
capture_instructions: Create a compact state diagram showing session-only bEnabled toggling the transient light, while individual light settings are stored in ULuxUserSettings and read during the next activation. Include the independent settings arrow.

caption: A project installation places the complete Lux plugin inside the project's Plugins folder.
alt: File Explorer showing the installed Lux plugin directory.
capture_instructions: Capture Windows File Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Lux, with Lux.uplugin, Source, Resources and Content visible, plus the full parent path in the address bar.

caption: Lux is registered with the Level Editor viewport's native toolbar controls.
alt: Lux position within the native Unreal Editor viewport toolbar.
capture_instructions: Capture the Level Editor toolbar with the Lux icon and its neighboring dropdown arrow highlighted immediately before the right-anchored viewport controls. Keep the surrounding toolbar items visible for orientation.

caption: Lux illuminates nearby scene geometry for inspection while leaving placed level lighting alone.
alt: Lux enabled in a dark Level Editor interior.
capture_instructions: Capture a dark interior in a perspective Level Editor viewport with Lux active. Show the Lux toolbar button and enough nearby geometry to reveal the headlamp's effect. Do not use a PIE or game camera.

caption: The Lux editor subsystem owns a temporary point light whose position follows the active perspective viewport.
alt: Lux architecture diagram of editor subsystem, viewport and transient light.
capture_instructions: Draw a technical flow from Level Editor toolbar to ULuxEditorSubsystem, transient movable UPointLightComponent, editor world and selected perspective camera. Label the world as Editor-only and show that no placed AActor or game-world module is created.
